svg.title: Interview AI project architecture diagram
svg.desc: Full-stack architecture showing Frontend React app, Backend Express API, MongoDB, and Google Gemini AI service

g.onclick: sendPrompt('What does the user do in this app?')
sendPrompt('Explain the AuthContext and useAuth hook in detail')
sendPrompt('Explain the InterviewContext and useInterview hook in detail')
sendPrompt('Explain the auth middleware and JWT blacklist in detail')
sendPrompt('Explain the auth controller — register, login, logout, getMe')
sendPrompt('Explain the interview controller in detail')
sendPrompt('Explain the AI service — generateInterviewReport and generateResumePdf')
sendPrompt('Explain pdf-parse and puppeteer usage in the project')
sendPrompt('Explain the MongoDB models — user, interviewReport, blacklistToken')
sendPrompt('How does the Gemini structured output work with Zod schema?')
sendPrompt('How does puppeteer generate the resume PDF?')
